aboutGame.title: What is Clone Builders?
paragraphs: Clone Builders is a Roblox building and automation game where a single builder unit creates copies of itself. Those clones gather resources, construct structures, defend the base, and feed machines, turning a slow trickle of workers into a self-running construction line.

Progress comes from balancing duplication, delegation, and escalation: spend resources to spawn more clones, assign them to harvest, haul, build, or defend, then reinvest in upgrades that raise the ceiling. This Clone Builders Wiki covers the core loop, resource tiers, upgrade priorities, controls, base layouts, and redeemable codes in plain-language guides.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Clone Builders.

items.question: What is Clone Builders?
items.answer: Clone Builders is a Roblox building and automation game where a single builder unit creates copies of itself. Those clones gather resources, construct structures, and feed machines, so a small crew can grow into a self-running construction line.

items.question: Do I need to spend Robux to progress in Clone Builders?
items.answer: No. Clone Builders can be played for free, and patient players reach the same milestones by keeping the clone loop running and buying multipliers before cosmetics. Paid options mainly speed up timers.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Clone Builders?
items.answer: Prioritize clone capacity and spawn economy first, because they multiply every other gain. Add production rate and cost reduction next, and save multiplicative or prestige upgrades for the mid and late game.

items.question: How do I get free rewards in Clone Builders?
items.answer: Redeem working codes in the in-game Settings or Codes menu. Codes are case-sensitive, expire without warning, and should only ever be claimed from the official game, never bought from a third-party page.

items.question: How many clones can I control in Clone Builders?
items.answer: Every clone-driven builder enforces a cap for performance and upkeep reasons. Find your current clone cap before building past it, because extra clones beyond a soft cap drain resources that upgrades would use better.

items.question: Where can I find Clone Builders guides and updates?
items.answer: This Clone Builders Wiki collects beginner steps, building and clone behavior guides, resource and upgrade priorities, controls, base layouts, codes, and an update tracker in one place.
